description: This file defines YAML configuration for message classes and structures related to the beerocks messaging protocol, including classes for network maps, stats, events, WiFi credentials, steering actions, topology, and various request/response message types.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_PING_REQUEST
classes.description: Class representing a ping request in the BML protocol.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_NW_MAP_RESPONSE
classes.description: Class representing a network map response containing node data and buffers.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_STATS_UPDATE
classes.description: Class representing stats update messages, including the number of stats bulks and buffer.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_WIFI_CREDENTIALS_SET_REQUEST
classes.description: Class for setting WiFi credentials, including SSID, network key, and other parameters.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_WIFI_CREDENTIALS_SET_RESPONSE
classes.description: Class for response to WiFi credentials set request, indicating success or error.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_STEERING_SET_GROUP_REQUEST
classes.description: Class representing a steering group request with group index and AP configurations.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_STEERING_CLIENT_SET_REQUEST
classes.description: Class for setting steering client configurations, including client MAC and steering options.
